title: Integrated network pharmacology and therapeutic verification of Dendrobium officinale flower on primary dysmenorrhea via inhibition of the TLR4/NF-kappaB/COX-2 pathway.
authors: Li, Manman; Sheng, Pei; Shi, Weiqing; Li, Weiguang; Li, Luqian; Wang, Xue; Wu, Haixia; Wang, Yuxin; An, Xiaofei; Wang, Lei; Yan, Ming
one_liner_zh: 该文研究石斛花提取物治疗原发性痛经的机制，涉及网络药理学和分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系完全无关。
abstract: Dendrobium officinale flowers (DOF) offer a wide range of therapeutic benefits due to their rich content of bioactive compounds. Traditionally used in Chinese medicine, these flowers are valued for their health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to their therapeutic effects. The anti-inflammatory and antioxidant extract of DOF exhibited anti-primary dysmenorrhea (PD) activity in oxytocin-induced mice. This study aimed to unravel the underlying mechanisms of DOF-EA in treating PD using an integrative approach that combines network pharmacology and experimental verification. The active fraction, DOF-EA, was identified through anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activity assays. The phytochemical profile of DOF-EA was characterized by HPLC analysis. The therapeutic mechanisms of DOF-EA in treating PD were predicted using network pharmacology and molecular docking analyses. Moreover, the therapeutic effects of DOF-EA were confirmed using oxytocin-induced mice and uterine strip models. Enzyme activity assays and immunoblotting methods were employed for target validation. DOF-EA inhibited COX-2 with an IC50 of 0.44 mug/mL, scavenged DPPH radicals with an IC50 of 9.88 mug/mL, and suppressed NO production in RAW 264.7 cells with an IC50 of 8.08 mug/mL. Additionally, DOF-EA reduced the writhing response and decreased TNF-alpha and PGF(2alpha) levels in PD mice. It also inhibited contraction activity in uterine strips by blocking calcium channels. Furthermore, DOF-EA downregulated the expression of TLR4, NF-kappaB, COX-2, and p-IkappaBalpha, while upregulating the expression of HO-1 and Nrf2 in the uterine tissue of PD mice. In conclusion, DOF-EA exerts therapeutic effects against PD by inhibiting TLR4/NF-kappaB/COX-2 and promoting the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway.
abstract_zh: 铁皮石斛花（DOF）因其丰富的生物活性化合物含量而具有广泛的治疗益处。传统上用于中药，这些花因其健康益处而受到重视，包括抗炎和抗氧化特性，这可能有助于其治疗效果。DOF的抗炎和抗氧化提取物在催产素诱导的小鼠中表现出抗原发性痛经（PD）活性。本研究旨在通过结合网络药理学和实验验证的综合方法，揭示DOF-EA治疗PD的潜在机制。通过抗炎和抗氧化活性测定，鉴定了活性组分DOF-EA。通过HPLC分析表征了DOF-EA的植物化学特征。使用网络药理学和分子对接分析预测了DOF-EA治疗PD的治疗机制。此外，使用催产素诱导的小鼠和子宫条模型确认了DOF-EA的治疗效果。采用酶活性测定和免疫印迹方法进行靶点验证。DOF-EA抑制COX-2，IC50为0.44 μg/mL，清除DPPH自由基，IC50为9.88 μg/mL，并在RAW 264.7细胞中抑制NO产生，IC50为8.08 μg/mL。此外，DOF-EA减少了PD小鼠的扭体反应，并降低了TNF-α和PGF(2α)水平。它还通过阻断钙通道抑制子宫条的收缩活动。进一步地，DOF-EA下调了PD小鼠子宫组织中TLR4、NF-κB、COX-2和p-IκBα的表达，同时上调了HO-1和Nrf2的表达。总之，DOF-EA通过抑制TLR4/NF-κB/COX-2并促进Nrf2/HO-1通路，对PD发挥治疗作用。
